blocks.title: Grammar Hook: Modals
blocks.body: You walk up to your teacher and say: 'I must borrow your pen' — or do you say 'may I borrow your pen'? The word you choose completely changes whether you sound polite, rude, certain, or doubtful. Modals are magic words that add MEANING to your sentences!
blocks.body_hi: आप अपने शिक्षक के पास जाते हैं और कहते हैं: 'मुझे आपकी कलम लेनी चाहिए' — या 'क्या मैं आपकी कलम ले सकता हूं'? जो शब्द आप चुनते हैं वह पूरी तरह से बदल देता है कि आप विनम्र, असभ्य, निश्चित या संदेहास्पद लगते हैं।
blocks.body_gu: Modals = magic words that add meaning — permission, ability, obligation, possibility.

blocks.question: Before we study Modals, can you try to identify the error in this sentence: 'She go to school every day'?
blocks.question_hi: सहायक क्रियाएं (Modals) सीखने से पहले, क्या आप इस वाक्य में त्रुटि पहचान सकते हैं?
blocks.explanation: Think about it! This is exactly what Modals helps us fix. Let us discover the rules together.
blocks.explanation_hi: यही सहायक क्रियाएं (Modals) सही करने में मदद करता है।

blocks.title: Discover: Modals in Real Life
blocks.title_hi: खोज: वास्तविक जीवन में सहायक क्रियाएं (Modals)
blocks.body: Look around you — Modals appears in every English text you read, every exam you write, every email you send. Mastering Modals = mastering English communication.
blocks.body_hi: सहायक क्रियाएं (Modals) हर अंग्रेजी पाठ में, हर परीक्षा में, हर ईमेल में दिखाई देता है। सहायक क्रियाएं (Modals) में महारत = अंग्रेजी संचार में महारत।
blocks.body_gu: Modals (સ. ક્.) — everywhere in English. Master it = master English.

blocks.title: The 9 Key Modals and Their Meanings
blocks.title_hi: 9 मुख्य सहायक क्रियाएं और उनके अर्थ
blocks.body:
CAN: Ability (I can swim) / Informal permission (Can I go?)
COULD: Past ability (I could run fast) / Polite request (Could you help me?)
MAY: Formal permission (May I come in?) / Possibility (It may rain)
MIGHT: Less certain possibility (It might rain)
MUST: Strong obligation/necessity (You must wear a seatbelt) / Certainty (She must be tired)
SHALL: Future (Shall we dance?) / Strong intention
SHOULD: Advice / Expectation (You should study)
WILL: Future / Determination
WOULD: Polite request (Would you help me?) / Conditional / Past habit
blocks.body_hi:
CAN: क्षमता / अनौपचारिक अनुमति
COULD: भूत क्षमता / विनम्र अनुरोध
MAY: औपचारिक अनुमति / संभावना
MIGHT: कम निश्चित संभावना
MUST: मजबूत दायित्व / निश्चितता
SHALL: भविष्य / प्रस्ताव
SHOULD: सलाह / अपेक्षा
WILL: भविष्य / इरादा
WOULD: विनम्र अनुरोध / भूत आदत
blocks.body_gu:
CAN: ક્ષ. / Inf. permit
COULD: ભ. ક્ষ. / Polite req.
MAY: Form. perm. / Poss.
MIGHT: Less poss.
MUST: Oblig. / Certainty
SHALL: Future / Offer
SHOULD: Advice / Expect
WILL: Future
WOULD: Polite req. / Past habit

blocks.title: Board Exam Tip: Modals
blocks.body: In CBSE Class 9 board exam, Modals questions appear in: (1) Fill in the blanks (2) Editing/Omission exercises (3) Rearranging jumbled sentences (4) Sentence transformation. Always justify your answer with the rule!
blocks.body_hi: CBSE Class 9 बोर्ड परीक्षा में सहायक क्रियाएं (Modals) प्रश्न आते हैं: (1) रिक्त स्थान भरना (2) संपादन/लोपन (3) अव्यवस्थित वाक्य (4) वाक्य परिवर्तन।
blocks.body_gu: Board exam — Modals (સ. ક્.) appears in: Fill blanks, Editing, Jumbled sentences, Transformation.

blocks.title: Solved Example 1: Modals
blocks.title_hi: हल किया गया उदाहरण 1: सहायक क्रियाएं (Modals)
blocks.problem: Choose: 'You _____ (must/should) not smoke here. It is strictly prohibited.'
blocks.problem_hi: चुनें: 'आप यहां धूम्रपान _____ नहीं (must/should) करते। यह सख्त रूप से प्रतिबंधित है।'
blocks.solution: MUST NOT. Rule: MUST NOT = strong prohibition (not allowed). SHOULD NOT = advice (not recommended). Since smoking is 'strictly prohibited' → must not.
blocks.solution_hi: MUST NOT। नियम: MUST NOT = मजबूत निषेध (अनुमति नहीं)। SHOULD NOT = सलाह।
blocks.solution_gu: MUST NOT = strong prohibition. SHOULD NOT = advice.

blocks.title: Solved Example 2: Modals
blocks.title_hi: हल किया गया उदाहरण 2: सहायक क्रियाएं (Modals)
blocks.problem: He _____ (can/could) play cricket very well when he was young.
blocks.problem_hi: वह जब युवा था तब क्रिकेट बहुत अच्छा _____ (can/could) खेलता था।
blocks.solution: COULD. Rule: CAN = present ability. COULD = past ability. 'when he was young' = past → COULD.
blocks.solution_hi: COULD। नियम: CAN = वर्तमान क्षमता। COULD = भूत क्षमता।

blocks.title: Solved Example 3: Modals
blocks.title_hi: हल किया गया उदाहरण 3: सहायक क्रियाएं (Modals)
blocks.problem: _____ (May/Can) I use your phone, please? (Formal request)
blocks.problem_hi: क्या मैं आपका फोन उपयोग कर _____ (May/Can) हूं? (औपचारिक अनुरोध)
blocks.solution: MAY. Rule: MAY = formal/polite permission. CAN = informal permission. In formal contexts (e.g., school exam, with elders) → use MAY.
blocks.solution_hi: MAY। नियम: MAY = औपचारिक/विनम्र अनुमति। CAN = अनौपचारिक।

blocks.question: 'You _____ respect your elders.' (Expressing moral obligation/advice)
blocks.question_hi: 'आप अपने बड़ों का सम्मान _____ करें।' (नैतिक दायित्व)
blocks.explanation: SHOULD = moral obligation, advice, or recommendation. CAN = ability. MIGHT = less certain possibility. WOULD = polite request/conditional.

blocks.question: 'She _____ be at home — all the lights are off.' (Logical deduction)
blocks.question_hi: 'वह घर पर _____ नहीं है — सभी रोशनी बंद है।' (तार्किक निष्कर्ष)
blocks.question_gu: Logical deduction: 'She _____ be at home, lights off.'
blocks.explanation: CAN'T = logical impossibility/deduction. When you are almost certain something is NOT true based on evidence → use can't. 'Lights are off' = strong evidence she's not home.
blocks.explanation_hi: CAN'T = तार्किक असंभावना। जब आप लगभग निश्चित हों कि कुछ सच नहीं है → can't।

blocks.question: Board Exam: Fill in — 'When I was a child, I _____ climb trees very fast.'
blocks.question_hi: Board: 'जब मैं बच्चा था, मैं पेड़ों पर बहुत तेज _____ चढ़ता था।'
blocks.question_gu: Board Fill: 'When child, I _____ climb trees fast.'
blocks.explanation: COULD = past ability. 'When I was a child' clearly sets the time in the PAST, so use COULD (not CAN which is present).
blocks.explanation_hi: COULD = भूत क्षमता। 'जब मैं बच्चा था' = भूतकाल।

blocks.question: '_____ you please pass me the salt?' (Very polite request)
blocks.question_hi: 'क्या आप _____ नमक पास कर सकते हैं?' (बहुत विनम्र अनुरोध)
blocks.question_gu: Very polite: '_____ you please pass salt?'
blocks.explanation: COULD = very polite request. While CAN is also used for requests, COULD is more polite and formal. In formal writing and board exams, COULD is preferred for polite requests.
blocks.explanation_hi: COULD = बहुत विनम्र अनुरोध। COULD, CAN से अधिक विनम्र है।

blocks.question: Board Editing: 'The doctor said I should to take rest.' Find the error.
blocks.question_hi: बोर्ड संपादन: 'डॉक्टर ने कहा मुझे आराम करना चाहिए।' त्रुटि खोजें।
blocks.question_gu: Board Editing: 'should to take rest' — error?
blocks.explanation: Modals (can, could, may, might, must, shall, should, will, would) are ALWAYS followed by V1 (base form) WITHOUT 'to'. Never say 'should to go' → say 'should go'.
blocks.explanation_hi: Modals हमेशा V1 (base form) के बाद आते हैं, 'to' के बिना।
blocks.explanation_gu: Modals + V1 (no 'to'). 'should to go' WRONG → 'should go' CORRECT.

blocks.title: Reflect & Apply
blocks.body: Write 5 sentences of your own using Modals. Try to use as many rules as you have learnt today. Then, check if you have used the rules correctly.
blocks.body_hi: सहायक क्रियाएं (Modals) का उपयोग करके अपने 5 वाक्य लिखें।
blocks.body_gu: Modals (સ. ક્.) use karke 5 sentences lakho.

blocks.title: Connection: Grammar in Writing
blocks.body: Modals connects to: Letter Writing (use correct tenses), Story Writing (maintain consistent tense), Comprehension passages (identify tenses used by the author), and all future English chapters.
blocks.body_hi: सहायक क्रियाएं (Modals) जुड़ा है: पत्र लेखन, कहानी लेखन, बोधगम्य अनुच्छेदों से।
blocks.body_gu: Modals (સ. ક્.) connects to: Letter writing, Story writing, Comprehension passages.

blocks.title: Mastery: Modals — Board Ready!
blocks.title_hi: महारत: सहायक क्रियाएं (Modals) — बोर्ड के लिए तैयार!
blocks.body: Excellent! You have completed Modals for Class 9. You can now confidently handle ALL board exam questions on Modals. Remember: Practice is the key to perfection!
blocks.body_hi: शानदार! आपने Class 9 के लिए सहायक क्रियाएं (Modals) पूरा किया। अब आप बोर्ड परीक्षा के सभी प्रश्न आत्मविश्वास से हल कर सकते हैं!
blocks.body_gu: Class 9 Modals (સ. ક્.) COMPLETE! Board exam ready!
